core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khuram is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Pleasant, cheerful, delightful”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khuram corresponds to the Arabic form خرم (Arabic root خ ر م (kh-r-m); خُرَّم (Khurram)). Its core sense is pleasant, cheerful, delightful. Khuram is Arabic خُرَّم (Khurram) 'pleasant, cheerful, delightful', from the root خ ر م (kh-r-m). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave the broken form خُرُوم and glossed the name 'Young Lion'; the correct form is خُرَّم. Same name as khurram.

persian.name: خرم
